title: Supporting material for: High F1, Costly Alerts: Dataset- and Prevalence-Dependent Rankings of Deep and Tree-Based DDoS Detectors
description: Tables and scripts that rebuild a prevalence and expected-cost reading of executed DDoS detector counts, including the ROC convex hull and the never-alert and always-alert bounds. The scripts rebuild the derived tables, including the BoT-IoT subsample counts in metadata/botiot_results.json. The interim public deposit is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23435601.
